card.name: Space before a number of days
card.fires_on: The space or small word right before a number of days or weeks, after phrases like "at least", "within", "every" or "more than". It expects a duration to follow.

modes.label: Space after time limit phrase
modes.description: A blank space after "at least", "within", "every" or "in" just before a duration number.
